messages.content:
Given a question and an answer, analyze the complexity of each sentence in the answer. Break down each sentence into one or more fully understandable statements. Ensure that no pronouns are used in any statement. Format the outputs in JSON.
Please return the output in a JSON format that complies with the following schema as specified in JSON Schema:
{"properties": {"statements": {"description": "The generated statements", "items": {"type": "string"}, "title": "Statements", "type": "array"}}, "required": ["statements"], "title": "StatementGeneratorOutput", "type": "object"}Do not use single quotes in your response but double quotes,properly escaped with a backslash.

--------EXAMPLES-----------
Example 1
Input: {
    "question": "Who was Albert Einstein and what is he best known for?",
    "answer": "He was a German-born theoretical physicist, widely acknowledged to be one of the greatest and most influential physicists of all time. He was best known for developing the theory of relativity, he also made important contributions to the development of the theory of quantum mechanics."
}
Output: {
    "statements": [
        "Albert Einstein was a German-born theoretical physicist.",
        "Albert Einstein is recognized as one of the greatest and most influential physicists of all time.",
        "Albert Einstein was best known for developing the theory of relativity.",
        "Albert Einstein also made important contributions to the development of the theory of quantum mechanics."
    ]
}
-----------------------------

Now perform the same with the following input
input: {
    "question": "user: How can I troubleshoot connectivity issues between my Watson Assistant chatbot and external APIs, ensuring that the necessary configurations are correctly set up and that there are no network-related obstacles?\nassistant: Sorry, but I do not have that information. \nuser: What is Watson Assistant?\nassistant: The IBM Watson® Assistant is an installable service that combines machine learning, natural language understanding, and integrated dialog tools to create conversation flows between your applications and users. You can build your own branded assistant for any device, application, or channel. This assistant connects to the customer engagement resources you already use, providing your customers with an engaging and unified problem-solving experience. Additionally, you can create a branded live chatbot, also known as an assistant, that seamlessly integrates with your existing customer engagement tools.\n\nuser: How do I build an assistant?\nassistant: To build an assistant using Watson Assistant for IBM Cloud Pak® for Data, you can follow these general steps:\n1. Create AI-driven conversational flows: Your assistant uses industry-leading AI capabilities to understand questions that your customers ask in natural language. It uses machine learning models that are custom built from your data to deliver accurate answers in real time.\n2. Embed existing help content: If you already know the answers to customer questions, you can put your subject matter expertise to work by adding a search skill to give your assistant access to corporate data collections that it can mine for answers.\n3. Bring the assistant to your customers: You can add your assistant as a chat widget to your company website or build your own custom app.\n4. Track customer engagement and satisfaction: Use built-in metrics to analyze logs from conversations between customers and your assistant to gauge how well it's doing and identify areas for improvement.\nuser: Chatbot\nassistant: Chatbot, which is also known as an assistant, connects to the customer engagement resources you already use to deliver an engaging, unified problem-solving experience to your customers.\nuser: Is IBM the only company that offers a branded live chatbot?\nassistant: I do not know.\nuser: How the assistant works?\nassistant: Watson Assistant enables customers to interact through various channels, including websites, messaging platforms, and call centers. When a customer starts a conversation, the assistant utilizes natural language understanding and machine learning models to interpret the customer's question and provide an accurate response in real time. The assistant can also be customized to incorporate existing help content, connect with customer service teams, and be integrated into popular social media platforms. Furthermore, the assistant's performance can be monitored using built-in metrics, allowing for the analysis of conversation logs to identify areas for improvement.\n\nuser: What is an Intent?",
    "answer": "意图（Intent）是客户输入中表达的目的或目标，例如回答问题或处理账单付款。识别出意图后，Watson Assistant 可以选择相应的对话流程来回应。[S2]"
}
Output:

statements: 意图（Intent）是客户输入中表达的目的或目标。
回答问题是意图的一个例子。
处理账单付款是意图的一个例子。
识别出客户输入中的意图后，Watson Assistant 可以选择与识别出的意图相对应的对话流程。
Watson Assistant 可以使用选定的对话流程回应客户。
